questions.q: What is the name of Tanjiro's demon sister?
questions.why: Nezuko was turned into a demon.

questions.q: Which demon lord is Tanjiro's chief antagonist?
questions.why: Muzan Kibutsuji is the main villain.

questions.q: What did Tanjiro do for a living before his family was attacked?
questions.why: After his father died, he sold charcoal in nearby villages to support his household.

questions.q: Tanjiro swings his sword using which technique, also known as Sun Breathing?
questions.why: He wields Hinokami Kagura, the Sun Breathing style, with his blade.

questions.q: Which Demon Slayer sends the Kamado siblings to train under Urokodaki?
questions.why: Giyu Tomioka points them to Urokodaki.

questions.q: What colour is Tanjiro's Nichirin blade?
questions.why: His blade is black, though it sometimes turns crimson.

questions.q: Which company animates the Demon Slayer TV anime?
questions.why: Ufotable produces the series, which premiered in April 2019.

questions.q: Tanjiro's earrings are patterned after which Japanese card game?
questions.why: Hanafuda earrings are among his trademarks.

questions.q: How many volumes did the Demon Slayer manga run?
questions.why: The manga ran from February 2016 to May 2020, in 23 volumes.

questions.q: Which swordsman hero inspired the scar on Tanjiro's face?
questions.why: Gotouge took the scar from Rurouni Kenshin's hero.
